_doc: Main control room layout (U4). Consumed by the Blender generator (U6) and the Unity LayoutCheck (U7); tested by ReactorSim.Core.Tests/InventoryTests. Units are metres and degrees. Room axes: x runs west-east (0..width), y runs front-back (0..depth), z is up. The board is an arc around arc.center: a point at angle t (degrees, measured from +y toward +x, so negative t is the left-hand end when facing the board) and radius r is (cx + r sin t, cy + r cos t). Sections run reactor, primary, safety, steam, turbine, electrical from start_deg to end_deg in that order; each section's panels sit side by side along its arc starting at start_deg, each panel a flat segment `width` metres wide whose face is at radius arc.radius and whose normal points at the centre. A panel's grid (see inventory.csv `slot`) is <surface>:<row>:<col>: `bench` is the sloped control surface (row 0 is nearest the operator), `vert` is the vertical panel (rows 0 to vertical.annunciator_rows-1 are the annunciator band, rows from vertical.annunciator_rows up are the instrument band, top row first). A grid cell is the kit footprint (kits.json) plus its label plate (label_plate), widened to grid.min_plate_width; annunciator tiles carry their own text (grid.no_label_plate_kits) and touch each other. Neighbouring cells keep spacing.min_gap (kits.json). system_sections maps the category path system/subsystem/function/device (longest prefix wins) to the section that owns the row. STAND_<section> is the viewpoint every row of that section is checked from; STAND_Center is the extra viewpoint for overview=y rows. checks holds the KTD8 thresholds. operating_points: pos is the eye position (x, y) in the room, eye_height is in metres, at_deg is the arc angle of the point (same convention as the board angle t), and facing_deg is the heading the operator faces, measured from +y toward +x like at_deg. An operator at a STAND_ or SEAT_ point faces the board, so facing_deg equals at_deg (it is not the direction from the board to the arc centre, which is at_deg + 180). STAND_Center faces heading 0; its cameras use headings_deg.

arc.note: KTD3 asked for about 120 deg at radius about 4.5 m (9.4 m of board). The 200 inventory rows need 15.2 m of panel at kit size, so the arc is 175 deg at radius 5.0 m (15.3 m of board). Revisit if rows are dropped or screens shared.

bench.note: depth is measured along the slope; the vertical panel face stands at the back edge

vertical.note: instrument band 0.9-1.6 m; annunciator band 1.6-1.8 m, tilted toward the operator

label_plate.note: every placed kit gets a label plate below it (above it on the bench); text height per KTD8 for its viewpoint distance

title_plate.note: one per panel, on the panel header above the annunciator band; every panel is at least this wide plus 2 x grid.edge_margin

section_sign.note: one lit sign per section, hung over the section's mid angle

mimic_stripe.note: a coloured stripe along the bench front lip of each section, colour = section.mimic_colour

floor_markings.stand_pads: a floor pad in the section's mimic colour under every STAND_<section>
floor_markings.bench_line: a yellow line 0.35 m in front of the bench front edge (do not cross while operating)

system_sections._doc: path prefix -> section; the path is system/subsystem/function/device; the longest matching prefix wins

SEAT_A1.note: chair at the reactor operating point; seated

SEAT_A2.note: chair on the turbine/electrical seam; seated

SPAWN_A1.note: spawn seated at the reactor desk (R5)

STAND_Center.note: arc centre: overview spot for the whole board and the annunciator row

CAM_Stand_Center.note: overview; one image per heading (the board spans 175 deg, wider than one frame)

overview.note: numerals must also be at least min_text_deg from STAND_Center; at radius 5.0 m that is about 79 mm

checks.occlusion: the row's kit must be the first collider hit on the ray from its viewpoint
checks.exists: every inventory row has a CTL_<id> parent in the scene
checks.label_text_note: Engraved label plates cap text at ~19 mm (25 mm plates), which is ~0.5-1.0 deg from the operating points (1.1-2.0 m). Labels are checked at min_label_text_deg; the full name and live value are always readable via the hover tooltip and wheel zoom (KTD4). min_text_deg still applies to gauge numerals and overview items.
